title: IIT Bombay Eligibility Criteria
content: Candidates must have passed Class 12 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as compulsory subjects. They must secure at least 75% aggregate marks (65% for SC/ST/PwD). Candidates must qualify JEE Advanced. The age limit is 25 years (30 years for SC/ST/PwD). Candidates who have appeared in JEE Advanced more than twice are not eligible.

title: IIT Bombay Required Documents
content: Required documents include: Class 10 mark sheet and certificate, Class 12 mark sheet and certificate, JEE Advanced rank card, Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), PwD certificate if applicable, Recent passport-sized photographs, Aadhar card or government ID proof, Transfer/Migration certificate from previous institution, Character certificate from school principal, Medical fitness certificate.

title: IIT Bombay Admission Deadlines 2025
content: JEE Advanced registration: March 2025. JEE Advanced exam: May 2025. JEE Advanced results: June 2025. JoSAA counselling Round 1: June end 2025. Seat acceptance and fee payment: Within 3 days of seat allotment. Document verification and physical reporting: July 2025. Commencement of classes: Late July 2025.

title: IIT Delhi Eligibility Criteria
content: Applicants must have qualified JEE Advanced with a valid rank. Minimum 75% marks in Class 12 board exams required (65% for reserved categories). Must have Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics in Class 12. Date of Birth must be on or after October 1, 2000 (general category). Students who have previously enrolled in any IIT are not eligible. Foreign nationals may apply through DASA scheme.

title: IIT Delhi Required Documents
content: Documents required for IIT Delhi admission: JEE Advanced scorecard with All India Rank, Class 10 certificate showing date of birth, Class 12 marksheet and passing certificate, Caste/category certificate issued by competent authority, Income certificate for EWS candidates, Disability certificate from government hospital, 6 passport photographs, Valid government photo ID (Aadhar/Passport), Original school leaving certificate.

title: IIT Delhi Admission Deadlines 2025
content: IIT Delhi follows JoSAA counselling schedule. Key dates: JoSAA Round 1 seat allotment: June 25, 2025. Document upload deadline: 48 hours after seat allotment. Fee payment deadline: 72 hours after seat allotment. JoSAA Round 2: July 5, 2025. Final reporting at institute: July 20-25, 2025. Classes begin: August 1, 2025.

title: IIT Madras Eligibility Criteria
content: For BTech programs: Qualified in JEE Advanced. Minimum aggregate of 75% in Class 12 (65% for SC/ST/PwD). Must have studied Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. Born on or after October 1, 2000 for General/OBC category. For PhD and MTech: Bachelor's degree in relevant engineering with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA. Valid GATE score required for MTech programs.

title: IIT Madras Required Documents
content: IIT Madras admission documents: Attested copy of JEE Advanced admit card and rank card, Class 10 board certificate (for age proof), Class 12 board marks statement and certificate, OBC-NCL/SC/ST/EWS certificate (if applicable), PwD certificate signed by medical board, Aadhar card (mandatory), Migration certificate, Conduct/character certificate, Medical fitness certificate from registered medical practitioner.

title: NIT Trichy Eligibility Criteria
content: For BTech: Valid JEE Main score required. Minimum 75% aggregate in Class 12 with PCM (65% for reserved category candidates). For supernumerary seats under home state quota, TNEA rank is also considered. For MTech programs: Relevant BE/BTech degree with 60% or equivalent CGPA. Valid GATE score required. For MCA: Graduation with Mathematics at 10+2 or degree level with 60% aggregate.

title: NIT Trichy Required Documents
content: Documents needed for NIT Trichy: JEE Main scorecard, Class 10 marksheet and certificate, Class 12 marksheet and passing certificate, Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), Income certificate for fee waiver, Passport size photographs (6 copies), Aadhar card or valid ID proof, School leaving/transfer certificate, Medical certificate from government doctor, Anti-ragging affidavit (to be submitted at time of joining).

title: NIT Trichy Admission Deadlines 2025
content: NIT Trichy BTech Admission Timeline: JEE Main Session 1: January-February 2025. JEE Main Session 2: April 2025. JoSAA Registration: June 2025. Round 1 Allotment: June 25, 2025. Online document submission: Within 48 hours of allotment. Round 6 (final): July 15, 2025. Institute reporting: July 25 - August 5, 2025. Orientation: August 7, 2025.

title: BITS Pilani Eligibility Criteria
content: For Integrated First Degree programs: Candidates must have passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with minimum 75% aggregate in these subjects. Must have qualified BITSAT with minimum scores as per cutoff. Indian nationals must be born on or after August 1, 2006 for 2025 admissions. No upper age limit for foreign nationals. Candidates awaiting Class 12 results can apply provisionally.

title: BITS Pilani Required Documents
content: Documents for BITS Pilani admission: Class 10 certificate (for date of birth), Class 12 mark sheet and certificate, BITSAT scorecard, 2 recent passport photographs, Photo identity proof (Aadhar/Passport/Voter ID), Caste certificate (if applying under reserved category), PwD certificate (if applicable), Gap year affidavit (if applicable), Medical fitness certificate, Declaration form filled by parents/guardian.

title: BITS Pilani Admission Deadlines 2025
content: BITS Pilani 2025 Schedule: BITSAT Application: January-March 2025. BITSAT Exam: May-June 2025. BITSAT Results: June 2025. Admission Form Fill-up: June-July 2025. Iteration 1 Allotment: July 2025. Fee Payment: Within 5 days of allotment. Final allotment and reporting: August 2025. Hostel allotment: On campus reporting.

title: VIT Vellore Eligibility Criteria
content: Candidates must have passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics/Biology with minimum 60% aggregate. Must qualify VITEEE. For NRI/foreign national category, different criteria apply. Candidates with valid JEE Main/JEE Advanced scores may get direct admission without VITEEE in certain programs. No restriction on number of attempts for VITEEE. Age limit: Born on or after July 1, 2004 for 2025 admissions.

title: VIT Vellore Required Documents
content: VIT Vellore admission documents: Class 10 marksheet and certificate, Class 12 marksheet, VITEEE rank card or JEE Main/Advanced scorecard, 3 recent passport photographs, Photo identity proof, Community certificate (for reserved categories), Income certificate (if applicable), Medical fitness certificate from authorized medical officer, Migration/school leaving certificate, Undertaking form available on VIT website.

title: VIT Vellore Admission Deadlines 2025
content: VIT Vellore 2025 Key Dates: VITEEE Application: November 2024 - March 2025. VITEEE Exam: April 2025. Results Declaration: April-May 2025. Online counselling Phase 1: May 2025. Phase 2 counselling: June 2025. Phase 3 and spot admission: June-July 2025. Last date for fee payment: As per allotment letter. Reporting and joining: July 2025.

title: IIT Kanpur Eligibility Criteria
content: BTech eligibility: JEE Advanced qualified. Minimum 75% marks in Class 12 (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics mandatory). 65% for SC/ST/PwD. Must not have previously enrolled in any IIT. Age: General candidates born on or after Oct 1, 2000. MSc admissions require bachelor's degree with 55% marks and valid JAM score. PhD applicants need master's degree with 55% and valid GATE/UGC-NET score.

title: IIT Kanpur Required Documents
content: Required documents for IIT Kanpur admission: JEE Advanced rank card and admit card, 10th board certificate (date of birth proof), 12th board marksheet and certificate, SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate (if applicable), PwD certificate from CMO/equivalent, Recent passport photographs (8 copies), Valid government ID (Aadhar preferred), Transfer certificate from previous school, Anti-ragging undertaking, Medical examination report.

title: IIT Kanpur Admission Deadlines 2025
content: IIT Kanpur follows JoSAA timeline: JoSAA opens: June 20, 2025. Choice filling deadline: June 24, 2025. Round 1 seat allotment: June 25, 2025. Fee and document submission: June 25-28, 2025. Rounds 2-6: July 2025 (approximately every 3 days). Physical reporting deadline: July 30, 2025. Academic calendar starts: August 2025. Late fee penalty applicable after reporting deadline.

title: General JEE Admission Process
content: The Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) has two stages: JEE Main conducted by NTA and JEE Advanced conducted by IITs. JEE Main qualifiers can apply to NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs through JoSAA. Top 2.5 lakh JEE Main qualifiers are eligible for JEE Advanced. JEE Advanced qualifiers can join IITs through JoSAA counselling. JoSAA (Joint Seat Allocation Authority) conducts centralized counselling for all IITs, NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs.

title: JoSAA Counselling Process
content: JoSAA counselling involves: Registration and choice filling on josaa.nic.in, Mock seat allotment for practice, 6 rounds of seat allotment, Document verification, Fee payment (provisional seat acceptance: Rs 35,000 for general; Rs 15,000 for SC/ST/PwD), Withdraw and cancellation rules, Reporting to allotted institute, Spot round for vacant seats. Candidates must respond in each round or their seat is cancelled.

title: College Admission Step-by-Step Checklist
content: Step 1: Register for entrance exam (JEE Main/JEE Advanced/BITSAT/VITEEE) well before deadline. Step 2: Appear for exam and note your score/rank. Step 3: Research colleges accepting your score range. Step 4: Prepare all documents (marksheets, certificates, ID proof, category certificates). Step 5: Register on counselling portal (JoSAA/CSAB/institute-specific). Step 6: Fill college and branch preferences carefully. Step 7: Accept allotted seat and pay provisional fee. Step 8: Upload documents for verification. Step 9: Report to the institute by the deadline. Step 10: Complete admission formalities including medical checkup and hostel allotment.

title: Fee Structure Overview for Top Engineering Colleges
content: IIT BTech fee per semester: General - Rs 1,00,000 to Rs 1,50,000 (hostel and mess extra ~Rs 30,000-50,000/semester). SC/ST/PwD with family income below 1 lakh: Full fee waiver. SC/ST/PwD with family income 1-5 lakh: 66% fee waiver. General with family income below 1 lakh: 66% fee waiver. BITS Pilani fee per semester: Rs 2,20,000 to Rs 2,50,000. NIT fee per semester: Rs 60,000 to Rs 80,000. VIT Vellore fee per semester: Rs 1,00,000 to Rs 1,40,000.

title: Reservation Policy in Central Institutions
content: Horizontal and vertical reservations apply in all centrally funded institutions: SC - 15%, ST - 7.5%, OBC-NCL - 27%, EWS - 10% (introduced in 2019). PwD (Persons with Disability) - 5% horizontal reservation across all categories. State universities may have additional state-level reservations. OBC certificate must confirm Non-Creamy Layer status. EWS candidates need income certificate from appropriate authority. Certificates must be issued by competent authority and be valid.

CSE ST: Opening 1, Closing 19. Electrical Engineering General: Closing 203. Mechanical Engineering General: Closing 700. Chemical Engineering General: Closing 1100. Civil Engineering General: Closing 1400. Aerospace Engineering General: Closing 1200. The CSE branch has the lowest (best) closing rank among all IITs making it the most competitive.

title: NIT Trichy JEE Main Rank Requirements
content: NIT Trichy opening and closing ranks (JEE Main 2024, All India Rank, Home State vs Other State): CSE Other State General: Closing ~3500. CSE Home State General: Closing ~8000. ECE Other State General: Closing ~7500. EEE Other State General: Closing ~11000. Mechanical Engineering Other State General: Closing ~14000. Civil Engineering Other State General: Closing ~22000. Chemical Engineering Other State General: Closing ~16000. Production Engineering Other State General: Closing ~28000. OBC-NCL ranks typically 2.5x to 3x the general closing rank. SC/ST candidates: approximately 5x to 8x the general closing rank cutoff.

title: NIT Warangal JEE Main Rank Requirements
content: NIT Warangal opening and closing ranks (JEE Main 2024, All India Rank): CSE Other State General: Closing ~5500. CSE Home State (Telangana) General: Closing ~12000. ECE Other State General: Closing ~9000. EEE Other State General: Closing ~13000. Mechanical Engineering Other State General: Closing ~18000. Civil Engineering Other State General: Closing ~28000. Metallurgical Engineering Other State General: Closing ~40000. OBC-NCL candidates: Multiply general rank by approximately 2.5. SC candidates: Multiply by approximately 6. ST candidates: Multiply by approximately 12.

title: BITS Pilani BITSAT Score Requirements
content: BITS Pilani BITSAT 2024 closing scores (out of 450): Pilani Campus - CSE: 398, ECE: 388, EEE: 372, Mechanical: 352, Chemical: 340, Civil: 330. Goa Campus - CSE: 388, ECE: 376, EEE: 360, Mechanical: 345. Hyderabad Campus - CSE: 375, ECE: 360, EEE: 345, Mechanical: 330. Dual Degree (BE+MSc) combinations have slightly different cutoffs. Physics closing score: Pilani 345, Goa 330. Chemistry Pilani 335. Mathematics Pilani 338. Students with 400+ score get any branch at any campus of their choice typically.

title: VIT Vellore VITEEE Rank Requirements
content: VIT Vellore VITEEE 2024 rank cutoffs (approximate): CSE (Core): Rank 1 to 3000. CSE with AI/ML specialization: Rank 1 to 5000. CSE with Data Science: Rank 1 to 6000. CSE Cyber Security: Rank 1 to 7000. ECE: Rank 1 to 12000. EEE: Rank 1 to 18000. Mechanical Engineering: Rank 1 to 25000. Civil Engineering: Rank 1 to 35000. Chemical Engineering: Rank 1 to 30000. Biotechnology: Rank 1 to 40000. Students with JEE Main rank below 50000 may receive direct admission offer without VITEEE for certain programs. VIT conducts multiple counselling rounds so late ranks may also get admission.

title: How to Use Your JEE Rank to Choose a College
content: JEE Advanced rank guidance: Rank 1-100: All IITs CSE/EE available. Rank 100-500: IIT Bombay/Delhi/Madras/Kanpur CSE borderline; good branches at all IITs. Rank 500-1500: Older IITs non-CSE branches; newer IITs CSE. Rank 1500-3000: Newer IITs; NIT Trichy/Warangal top branches. Rank 3000-5000: NIT system top colleges CSE. JEE Main rank guidance: Rank 1-5000: NIT Trichy/Warangal/Surathkal CSE. Rank 5000-15000: Good NITs ECE/EEE. Rank 15000-30000: NITs Mechanical/Civil. Rank 30000-80000: NITs core branches, newer NITs CSE. Always check previous year cutoffs on josaa.nic.in and csab.nic.in for exact figures.

content: IIT Hyderabad opening and closing ranks (JEE Advanced 2024): CSE General: Closing ~950. CSE OBC-NCL: Closing ~420. CSE SC: Closing ~280. ECE General: Closing ~1800.
